articles.title: EU says Apple Ads and Maps likely qualify as gatekeepers
articles.content: STORY: The EU Commission said Friday Apple Ads and Apple Maps could likely be deemed “gatekeepers” under the bloc’s digital rules. The Commission has 45 working days to decide whether to designate Apple as a gatekeeper for any of these services.If designated, Apple will have six months to comply.Apple said in a response on Friday that it had submitted official rebuttals to the pre-designation notification.It said Apple Ads is not a large player in the online advertising services market in the EU, and has minimal share compared to rivals such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok or X.It also said Maps has very limited usage in the EU compared to other services like Google Maps and Waze.
